title: Electrical Motors - Service Factors
description: Calculate design power based on motor power and service factor. Service factor (SF) is a measure of periodic overload capacity at which a motor can operate without being damaged.

components.content:
## Service Factor Calculator

Service factor (SF) is a measure of periodically overload capacity at which a motor can operate without being damaged.

**Formula:**

_PD = SF × P_

Where:
- _PD_ = Design Power (hp or W)
- _SF_ = Service Factor
- _P_ = Motor Power (hp or W)

A motor operating continuously at a service factor greater than 1 will have a reduced life expectancy compared to operating at its rated nameplate horsepower.

### NEMA Service Factor Reference

The table above shows NEMA service factors for drip-proof motors at various synchronous speeds and power ratings.

**Example:** A 1 HP motor with a Service Factor of 1.15 can operate at:

_PD = 1 hp × 1.15 = 1.15 hp_

without overheating or damaging the motor (assuming rated voltage and frequency are supplied).

**Note:** Insulation life and bearing life are reduced by operating at service factor loads.
